name: Furtal
description:
Furtal is a furry convention held in Fortaleza, Ceará, in northeastern Brazil. It's all about celebrating anthropomorphic art, creativity, and the furry community through a fun and immersive experience.

Every edition tells a brand-new story, and everyone who attends becomes part of it. Join a kingdom, complete quests, earn rewards, meet new characters, and help shape the adventure through interactive activities inspired by fantasy RPGs.

Besides the story, you'll find an Artist Alley, fursuit-friendly activities, games, workshops, performances, themed attractions, and plenty of opportunities to hang out with other furry fans. 

We believe stories aren't meant to be watched. They're meant to be lived! So come join us and discover how a furry convention can make you feel like you've stepped into a living fantasy world, rather than simply attending an event.
